# Home Call Relay
> Free homeowner referral network connecting homeowners with independent local home-service providers. Currently serving plumbing in Silver Spring, MD and nearby Montgomery County (https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/). Phone (240) 226-3502.

## Services (Silver Spring, MD plumbing)
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/services/emergency-plumber/): For a burst pipe or major leak, shut off your main water valve first (usually where the water line enters the basement or crawl space, near the meter). For sewage coming up a floor drain, stop running water and call WSSC Water's 24-hour line (301-206-4002) as well as a WSSC-registered plumber. Then call (240) 226-3502 and we'll connect you with a local plumber.
- [Drain Cleaning](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/services/drain-cleaning/): If only one fixture is slow, it's a local clog that a plunger, a hand auger or a plumber's cable can usually clear. If several fixtures back up at once, or the basement floor drain gurgles when you flush, the clog is probably in the main sewer line and needs a WSSC-registered drain cleaner.
- [Water Heater Repair & Replacement](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/services/water-heater-repair-replacement/): A tank water heater usually lasts about 8–12 years. If yours is in that range and leaking from the tank itself, plan to replace it. Leaks from fittings, valves or a bad thermostat or element are usually repairable. In WSSC Water's area (Montgomery and Prince George's counties), replacing a gas water heater requires a WSSC permit, a WSSC-licensed gasfitter and an inspection. A like-for-like electric swap is usually permit-exempt. See our water heater permit guide for the details.
- [Leak Detection](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/services/leak-detection/): Turn off every faucet and appliance, then check your water meter. If the dial or low-flow indicator still moves, you have a leak. Running toilets are the most common cause of a sudden jump in your WSSC Water bill. Put a few drops of food coloring in the tank. If color shows up in the bowl without flushing, the flapper is leaking.
- [Sewer Line Repair](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/services/sewer-line-repair/): In WSSC Water's area, the homeowner owns the sewer lateral from the house to the property line, and WSSC maintains the section from the property line to the main. Always start with a sewer camera inspection (typically $275–$550 in Silver Spring) and a copy of the video before agreeing to dig. Published 2026 Silver Spring estimates run roughly $1,500–$5,000 for a single-spot repair, $3,300–$16,500 for open-trench lateral replacement, and $4,400–$22,000 for trenchless pipe bursting (or $90–$275/ft for cured-in-place lining). Any underground sewer repair requires a WSSC Water permit pulled by a WSSC-registered master plumber.
- [Toilet & Faucet Repair](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/services/toilet-faucet-repair/): A running toilet is usually a worn flapper or a fill valve, and both are cheap parts. A dripping faucet usually needs a cartridge or washer. Call a plumber if the toilet rocks or leaks at the base (the wax seal or flange), or if the shutoff valves under it are old and won't turn.
- [Sump Pumps & Basement Water](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/services/sump-pump/): If your basement floods during heavy summer storms, check that the sump pump float moves freely and the pump runs when you pour water into the pit. A battery backup keeps it running during power outages, which often come with the same storms. If sewage, not groundwater, comes up the floor drain, the problem is a sewer backup, not the sump pump.

## Guides
- [Sewer Backup in Silver Spring: Who Pays, You or WSSC Water?](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/guides/sewer-backup-who-pays-wssc-silver-spring/): It depends on where the blockage is. In WSSC Water's area (Montgomery and Prince George's counties, including Silver Spring), the owner is responsible for the sewer service line from the house to the property line. WSSC Water maintains the rest, out to its main. If the blockage turns out to be on WSSC's side, WSSC clears it at no charge. You still pay the plumber who diagnosed it, but you can ask WSSC's Claims Office about reimbursement if roots or a broken WSSC pipe caused it. One exception: if your house connects to a WSSC main that runs through a right-of-way on your own property, WSSC maintains only the actual connection to the main.
- [High WSSC Water Bill? Find the Leak and Get It Adjusted](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/guides/wssc-high-water-bill-leak-adjustment/): Most surprise WSSC bills come from a leak, and toilets are the most common culprit. WSSC also charges a higher price per gallon as your average daily use goes up, so a leak raises both the gallons and the rate. You pay for water that passes the meter, but WSSC's regulations allow adjustments: up to six months of excess water and sewer charges for an underground leak repaired under a WSSC permit, excess sewer charges for leaks that never reached a drain (burst pipes, crawl spaces, hose bibs), and 50% of the excess for an unexplained bill at least three times your usage a year earlier. Email requests to customerservice@wsscwater.com.
- [Do You Need a Permit to Replace a Water Heater in Silver Spring?](https://homecallrelay.com/plumbing/silver-spring/guides/water-heater-permit-wssc-montgomery-county/): It depends on the fuel. In Silver Spring and the rest of Montgomery and Prince George's counties, WSSC Water (not a city or county building office) issues plumbing and gas permits. Replacing a gas water heater requires a WSSC permit, a WSSC-licensed master gasfitter to do the work, and a WSSC inspection within 10 business days. Homeowners aren't allowed to install gas appliances. Replacing an electric water heater like-for-like is exempt from the permit requirement under the WSSC Plumbing and Fuel Gas Code, as long as no concealed piping is replaced and no pipes or valves are rearranged. The pre-paid Short Form permit is $180 (effective July 1, 2026), and the inspection is included.
